method: Protected frames [0,48), [264,288), and [600,624) were copied unchanged. In damaged sections, OpenCV colored non-local-means denoising was applied with restrained strengths (luma h=5.5, chroma h=9), followed by a low-weight bidirectional Farneback motion-compensated neighbor blend gated by forward/backward flow consistency and photometric agreement. No exposure normalization, crop, frame synthesis, or frame reordering was applied. The master was encoded as lossless FFV1 from 8-bit BGR/RGB samples; the repair layer stores the signed correction using the supplied replay convention.
color_contract: 8bit displayRGB, same candidate transform; no linear/mastering reinterpretation
limitations: No clean frame reference or hidden target was available, so denoising strength was selected by visual inspection of input frames and restrained to avoid smoothing hand and control-panel edges. Optical flow can be less reliable at occlusions and during fast motion; flow confidence reduces but cannot eliminate temporal blending errors. The authored warm sweep and cool dimming were left in the source signal, so any source flicker not separable from those effects remains.
